newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Communist China refuses to take in convicted murderers extradited by Taiwan.
Water supply suffers contamination in China; 20 million people affected.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan reports hog foot and mouth disease.
Taiwan to completely liberalise sales of farm land by end 1997.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwanese murder suspects to return from Canada for trial in Taiwan.
Mass food poisoning breaks out in junior high school.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Mainland Chinese company takes control of Panama Canal.
Taiwan to investigate illegal investments in mainland China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Stock market closes lower in huge turnover.
Pou Chen denies bank investment in China.
